answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital lockup. To prevent cheap identity generation, the network requires a jade validator status, earned by holding a yarrow token stake. This creates an economic oasis where malicious actors face prohibitive costs, as the expenditure required to acquire enough collateral to subvert consensus far outweighs the potential utility of deploying multiple fake agent personas within the ledger.
